import re

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric chars with a single hyphen, no trailing
    result = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Remove trailing punctuation
    result = result.rstrip('-')
    return result

def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + '...'

# Test cases from the test file
test_cases = [
    ('Hello World', 'hello-world'),
    ('  a   b  ', 'a-b'),
    ('C++ rocks!', 'c-rocks'),
    ('abc', 'abc'),
    ('abcdefghij', 'abcde...')
]

    result = slugify(text)
    truncated = truncate(result, len(text))
    print(f'{text!r} -> {result!r}, truncate({len(text)}): {truncated!r} (expected: {expected!r})')
"

import re

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric chars with a single hyphen, no trailing
    result = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Remove trailing punctuation
    result = result.rstrip('-')
    return result

def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + '...'

# Test cases from the test file
test_cases = [
    ('Hello World', 'hello-world'),
    ('  a   b  ', 'a-b'),
    ('C++ rocks!', 'c-rocks'),
    ('abc', 'abc'),
    ('abcdefghij', 'abcde...')
]

print('Testing slugify and truncate:')

    result = slugify(text)
    truncated = truncate(result, len(text))
    status = '✓' if truncated == expected else '✗'
    print(f'{status} {text!r} -> {result!r}, truncate: {truncated!r} (expected: {expected!r})')
